checks.text: On load, the page shows the heading "Card Memory Match", 16 buttons named "Card 1" to "Card 16" each with the text "?", the text "Score: 0", and the text "Best: 0".
Clicking "Card 1" makes its text "A"; "Card 2" still reads "?" and "Score: 0" is shown.
Clicking "Card 1" then "Card 2" shows "A" and "B", and within 3 seconds both read "?" again; "Score: 0" is shown.
Clicking "Card 1" then "Card 16" leaves both reading "A" and shows "Score: 1" and "Best: 1".
Clicking "Card 1" twice leaves it reading "A" and "Score: 0" is shown; then clicking "Card 16" shows "Score: 1".
After matching "Card 1" and "Card 16", clicking "Restart" makes all 16 cards read "?" and shows "Score: 0" and "Best: 1".
After matching "Card 1" and "Card 16", clicking the heading and pressing "r" makes all 16 cards read "?" and shows "Score: 0" and "Best: 1".
Reload keeps the game: after matching "Card 1" and "Card 16" and reloading, both read "A", "Card 2" reads "?", and the page shows "Score: 1" and "Best: 1".
Reload keeps the best score: after matching "Card 1" and "Card 16", clicking "Restart" and reloading, the page shows "Score: 0" and "Best: 1".
